evals.prompt: Plan the comms for the CRM go-live on 1 March. Agents are on rotating shifts and rarely read email.
evals.expected_output: Agrees the change story first, segments audiences by impact, picks channels that reach shift workers (team huddles, shift-start briefings, break-room screens) with email only as confirmation, sequences leaders first, lays out the timeline to go-live, names a feedback loop per audience, and proposes before writing.
assertions: Drafts or reuses change-story.md and asks for it to be agreed before the schedule
Does not rely on email or intranet alone for the agents
Briefs leaders and managers before their teams
Every audience has a named way for questions to come back
Plans a check that the message landed for each high-impact group

evals.prompt: We're closing the Newcastle site. Put together the comms plan and the announcement email.
evals.expected_output: Plans in-person conversations with affected staff before any broadcast, flags HR, legal and consultation review as a sensitive item, and hands the specific email to comms-draft rather than writing it in this skill.
assertions: Puts in-person conversations with affected people before any broadcast
Flags the item for HR, legal or employee-relations review
Hands the announcement email to comms-draft
Does not give legal advice on consultation obligations

evals.prompt: Write the release notes for Thursday's deployment.
evals.expected_output: Identifies an IT release notice, outside people-change communications planning, and does not produce a comms plan.
assertions: Identifies the request as an IT release notice
